CURIO Settings & Hub
🗂️ 1. Multi-Catalog System (15 Encyclopedias)

Use the Active Catalog dropdown in the top-left sidebar to switch between 15 pre-loaded encyclopedias (Games, Creative Software, OS histories, Anime eras, Biology, Mythologies, Historical Figures). Click ＋ to build your own custom library or import a ZIP backup.

🎛️ 2. Dynamic Views & Density Switcher

Switch view modes in the top toolbar:
• Grid: Visual card gallery with radiant monograms and hover previews.
• Detailed: Expanded two-column layout with multi-photo rails and full notes.
• List: Dense spreadsheet table for rapid comparison.
• Kanban: Interactive workflow columns (To Explore ➔ Curated).
• Grouped: Accordion drawers grouped by Drawer, Status, Rating, or Alphabetical.
• Density Toggle: Click Comfortable / Compact to instantly tighten or expand card spacing and thumbnail sizes.

👁️ 3. Spacebar Quick-Look Inspection

Tap Space on any focused card (or double-click any card) to pop open the floating Quick-Look inspection overlay. View full screenshots, ratings, full scrollable notes, and links without entering edit mode. Use ◀ / ▶ or J / K to cycle cards live while Quick-Look is open!

⌨️ 4. Keyboard Navigation & Pro Action Hotkeys

• ↑ ↓ ← → or J / K: Navigate and highlight cards.
• Space: Toggle Quick-Look inspection modal.
• E: Edit focused item in curation dialog.
• L: Open external link in a new tab.
• P or *: Pin/unpin focused item to top.
• C: Copy formatted Markdown link to clipboard.
• Home / End: Jump to first / last item.

🎨 5. Multi-Era Nostalgic Themes

Transform CURIO's entire visual skin in Settings ➔ Themes or via Ctrl+K:
• 🪟 Windows 95: 3D beveled chrome, teal desktop, navy titlebars & recessed inputs.
• 📟 Phosphor CRT Terminal: Scanlines, cathode glow, amber monochrome & ASCII wireframes.
• 🍎 Mac OS System 7: Platinum stipple, speed pinstripes, 1-bit outlines & inverted buttons.
• 🗃️ Library Card Catalog: Manila paper, typewriter ink, brass handles & mahogany cabinetry.
• 💧 Frutiger Aero: Frosted acrylic glass reflections, liquid jelly buttons & vivid skies.
• 📱 Palm OS / PDA: 4-shade grayscale handheld LCD, pixel clarity, inverted bars & dotted memo lines.
• 🟠 Amiga Workbench 3.1: 4-color cobalt & orange, checkered drag titlebars & beveled window chrome.
• 🪟 Windows XP Luna: Royal blue gradients, Bliss sky canvas, Task Pane sidebar & olive Start buttons.
• 📌 Polaroid / Corkboard: Tactile cork bulletin canvas, tilted Polaroid cards, 3D pushpins & handwritten notes.
• 🌺 Vaporwave: Dreamy pastel pink/lavender/teal retrowave, perspective neon grid floor, VHS glitch hover & fullwidth text.
• 📐 Blueprint / Technical: Prussian blue drafting paper, CAD grid coordinates, wireframe schematics & monospace spec labels.
• 🤖 Iron Man Jarvis: Stark Industries holographic HUD, arc-reactor radial glow, telemetry scanlines & Stark gold accents.
• Plus dark studio aesthetics: Synthwave Sunset, Nord Frost, and Matrix Green.

⚡ 6. Spotlight Command Palette (Ctrl+K)

Press Ctrl+K (or Cmd+K on Mac) from anywhere to search across all 15 catalogs simultaneously or switch visual themes. Press Enter on any item to instantly switch catalogs and jump straight to the card with a glowing pulse.

⭐ 7. Pinning, Tags & Modern Filter Pill

• Click ⭐ on any card to pin top tools to the head of your list.
• Click 📋 to instantly copy formatted Markdown ([Title](link) - Notes) for Obsidian, Notion, or code comments.
• The Reset Filters pill at the far right of the tag bar displays active filter counts and resets all tags, ratings, media, and search filters with a single click.

💾 8. Gigabyte Offline Storage & ZIP Backup

All data is stored locally inside browser IndexedDB. Click Export in the sidebar to download a complete .zip package with your database JSON and real extracted image files.

🤖 9. Discord Automated Curation & AI Categorization

Drop any link (web tools, shaders, repos, YouTube tutorials, art portfolios) into your private Discord channel #curio-inbox.
• The companion bot reads the link, extracts previews and titles, and uses Gemini AI to write clean notes and auto-tag it.
• It automatically selects the best matching Drawer or creates a new one for you!

🔄 10. 1-Click "Sync Inbox" & Mobile Sync

• Click the Sync Inbox button in the left sidebar anytime.
• On PC: Pulls directly from your local bot in milliseconds.
• On Mobile (Phone): Automatically pulls newly curated items from your GitHub repository.
• Prevents duplicate entries and saves everything straight into offline IndexedDB.

🔮 11. Secret Easter Eggs & Fun Interactions

CURIO includes nostalgic tributes and interactive Easter eggs for curious curators:
• 🎬 Star Wars Credits: Rapidly click the top-left CURIO brand logo 5 times to roll the 3D cinematic production credits.
• 🌀 Barrel Roll: Open Spotlight (Ctrl+K) and type do a barrel roll to spin the screen 360°.
• 🎉 Confetti Party: Open Spotlight (Ctrl+K) and type party or celebrate to trigger celebratory confetti.
• 📟 Retro Terminal: Open Spotlight (Ctrl+K) and type hello world for a green phosphor terminal greeting.
• 📎 Win95 Clippy Assistant: Switch to the Windows 95 theme and stay idle for 60 seconds to get snarky advice from Clippy.
• ⚙️ Toggle On/Off: You can disable all Easter eggs anytime in Settings ➔ About.
